text:
Priya (Product): quick follow-up from the all-hands Q&A: several teams asked for crisp dates on three items — 1) API streaming/backpressure improvements, 2) per-route Console metrics & traces, 3) Optimize auto-quant recommendations. can leadership give short targets so eng/planning can align? :mag_right:

Alex (CTO): short bullets: streaming improvements: internal beta by 2024-07-26, public beta ~2024-08-15. Console per-route metrics: staged beta (hosted) in Aug, Dedicated visibility in Nov. Optimize auto-quant: experimental alpha in Sept (Q3), wider beta in Oct, GA tentatively in Dec (Q4). note these are targets, subject to pilot/infra risk.

Sam (PM): adding context: streaming work is focused on KV-cache reuse + adaptive batching to lower p95. target improvement ~20-30% p95 for typical multi-turn chat. priority routing (route->lane) is part of the same effort but is a separate pilot (early Q3).

Jordan (Eng): implementation caveat: priority lanes require scheduler + autoscaler changes, and new cache eviction semantics. we have two risk areas: node churn under heavy prefix caching, and cross-tenant memory isolation. current spike tests show a potential regression at 2x simulated load; if that persists we'll delay pilot by 2-3 weeks. we'll post detailed test results in eng-runtime.

Elena (Support): request: we need a clear customer migration plan before beta flips. can we include automated warnings in SDKs and a console migration UI? also need runbooks for rollback steps.

Priya (Product): yes — plan is: SDK deprecation warnings (30/60 day cadence), Console migration toggle per route (opt-in), and a visible rollback button that restores previous routing/streaming mode. we'll coordinate comms with Support and Solutions.

Maya (Solutions): ping for pilot customers: we have 3 accounts interested in early priority lanes pilot. Sam/Jordan — please DM me the enrollment checklist so we can set expectations.

Sam (PM): example internal feature flags for experiments: ```json
{"streaming_mode":"adaptive-backpressure","priority_lanes":true,"optimize_auto_quant":"alpha"}
```

DeployBot: deployment started: infra/scheduler-spike-tests -> canary group (10%) at 2024-06-18T15:42:00Z

Jordan (Eng): noted DeployBot. canary will exercise priority lanes codepath. i'll watch metrics and shout if we see regressions.

Kai (CEO): high-level reminder: default to safe rollouts for anything that touches Dedicated customers' SLA. automatic fallback to previous behavior must be enabled for all canaries. prioritize observability and short mean time to rollback.

Alex (CTO): agreed. i'll ensure fallback policies are enforced by the deployment tooling. i'll publish a short timeline doc with caveats and risks in this thread by COB today.

Priya (Product): thanks! once Alex posts the doc i'll add a short FAQ card to the Console roadmap and link to the pilot sign-up for Solutions. follow-ups in this thread or ping @Sam/@Jordan. :raised_hands:
